data_exchange_osrd_desc: An open source web application for railway infrastructure design, capacity analysis, timetabling and simulation
data_exchange_alignment_desc: Exchange format {{version}} – horizontal and vertical alignment per track, with every design parameter. Not OSRD RailJSON.
data_exchange_import_err_unsupported_ver: Project comes from an older version and cannot be loaded
import_conflict_message: Project '{{title}}' already exists. Which version do you want to keep?
import_track_conflict_message: Track '{{name}}' already exists. Which version do you want to keep?
data_exchange_dbref_desc: Like the MDB import, but the coordinates are converted for good: every track is carried into the chosen DB_REF zone and stored there. The nodes stay exact and the lengths and radii are refitted to them. Where a regional grid covers the area it is loaded for that one conversion.
data_exchange_mdb_grid_none: No regional grid for this area – transformed with BeTA2007 (nationwide).
data_exchange_mdb_moved: {{n}} tracks carried into {{crs}}. Nodes taken over exactly, lengths and radii refitted (up to {{mm}} mm per metre); tangents at the joints opened by at most {{deg}}°.
data_exchange_mdb_links: Links created: {{n}} ({{crs}} of them a change of system) – see Switches → Link track ends.
data_exchange_mdb_fanned: Skipped: {{n}} places with more than two track ends – those want a switch, not a link.
data_exchange_reports_desc: What an import had to report — elements skipped, switches added, where the file contradicts itself. The last eight runs of this project, kept across a reload.
data_exchange_reports_none: No import in this project yet.
data_exchange_reports_save: Save report as a text file
data_exchange_mdb_desc: Inventory database of the ASCII interface. The file is sent to the server to be converted and deleted there afterwards. Every track keeps the plane it was surveyed in.
data_exchange_mdb_err_empty: No alignment elements with a line number in the file.
data_exchange_mdb_err_unavailable: The conversion service cannot be reached.
data_exchange_mdb_err_not_a_database: That is not an Access database.
data_exchange_mdb_err_no_records: The database holds no ASCII-interface records.
data_exchange_mdb_err_too_large: The file is too large for the service.
data_exchange_mdb_err_busy: The service is busy — please try again.
data_exchange_mdb_err_invalid_payload: The file could not be read.
data_exchange_csv_desc: Alignment elements from the track layout export. State the plane the file is in; the coordinates are transformed into the target system, the angles and parameters are taken as stated.

info_description: This tool lets you create track geometry for operational simulations. The data can currently be exported for use in OSRD.
info_layers: Choose the background map that fits as a planning base – for instance OpenStreetMap, aerial imagery or terrain models.
info_places: Plan new, standalone tracks – as a straight line, a curve, or offset in parallel to an existing element or track.
info_connect: Extend existing tracks at their end node with straights or curves, with transition curves and cant where needed.
info_connect_switch: Place plain switches, curved switches, crossings or crossing switches – at the end of an element or inserted into an existing track, across several straights, curves and clothoids if needed. Connect two parallel tracks with a calculated switch connection.
info_splice: Join two straights with an arc, or two arcs with a straight (including clothoids), for a smooth, continuous alignment.
info_edit: Select an element to adjust its length and radius or delete it. For a track you can edit its properties, reverse its direction, open the table editor or delete it.
info_optimize: Raise the achievable speed by improving curve radii within an offset corridor – for a whole track or a single arc, with an optional global optimization (Python).
info_platform: Select a track and two points on it to lay out a platform. Its edges follow the track on the side you choose; you state the height above top of rail.
info_cross_section: Pick an element to see its cross section – the clearance profile the project is designed against, the superstructure of its track, and what cant and curvature do to both.
info_data: Import and export data – as a project file, individual tracks, survey data, CSV, or for OSRD.
info_elevation: Show a track's elevation profile and fill in missing heights automatically from the terrain model.
info_plan: Export a scale plan (1:500/1:1000) as PDF, split across multiple sheets if needed – with title block, scale bar, north arrow and background map.
scurve_no_solution: No solution: the tracks meet at too sharp an angle.
scurve_too_short: Intermediate element shorter than the switch form's minimum.
scurve_too_sharp: Tracks converge too much: the intermediate curve is too sharp for this speed.
scurve_hint_no_bloss: A switch connection cannot lie on a Bloss curve – its pieces are no Bloss curves.
scurve_branch_too_sharp: The turnout bent into the curve gets too sharp for this speed.
scurve_cant_mismatch: The two tracks carry different cant – the middle element would need a ramp.
scurve_cant_over: Cant above 100 mm: no turnout may be laid there.
plan_intro: Creates a to-scale site plan of the tracks as a PDF.
plan_background_failed: Background map could not be loaded – plan without background.
plan_km_missing: No kilometrage line in the project – give a track a line number and it is fetched.
plan_legend: UA/UE transition start/end · BA/BE arc start/end · TA/TE alignment start/end · stations km+m
plan_overflow: The tracks do not fit on one sheet – switch on splitting, or pick a larger format or 1:1000.
cross_section_hint: Pick a track from the list or click it on the map – the overlay's slider walks the section along it.
cross_section_rail_default: Default: rail over the whole track
cross_section_sleeper_default: Default: sleeper over the whole track
cross_section_use_switch_zone: 15 m before and after a switch
platform_hint_track: Select the track the platform runs along on the map.

platform_hint_end: Click the end point of the platform on the track

elevation_hint: Click a track on the map, or pick one from the list, to see its profile. Tracks without heights get them automatically from the terrain (DGM5 of the BKG, MapTiler Terrain outside Germany); a track that grows only has the new stretch read. Heights edited by hand stay until the track is reloaded.
elevation_reload_track: Reload the track’s heights from the terrain
elevation_no_heights: No heights for this track yet.
elevation_hint_edit: Click a point to change its height. Ctrl/Shift-click picks more, Shift-drag draws a box. Wheel zooms, drag pans.
elevation_delete_hint: The first and the last point stay — that is where the height meets the joined tracks.
elevation_vcurve_hint: Radius of the vertical curve at the gradient change in m; 0 removes it.
